Forget marches. Forget petitions. Forget changing your profile picture. The [whole job](../appendix/humanity-manager-employment-agreement.qmd) is one day a year, and here is the thirty-minute version you can do right now, once.

## Action 1: VOTE (2 Minutes)

Go to the referendum site, prove you're a human, and vote YES on the 1% treaty. For all of human history, the split between weapons and curing the people you love was decided without asking you. This is the part where you get asked. Your vote joins the 280-million-vote flood, and nobody can buy it off you.

![Three steps: visit website, prove you're not a robot, vote yes. Easier than voting for president, harder than liking a cat video.](/assets/images/three-actions/three-actions-section-action-1-vote-2-minutes-bw-academic.jpg)

## Action 2: INVEST (10 Minutes, Optional)

This one is optional: the vote and the recruiting are the job; money is the amplifier. If you have the means, an investment in **[VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd)** is not a donation. It's a high-risk, high-reward bet on the future of the human race with a projected {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}}. This is the fuel. This is what buys the lobbyists, the ads, and the politicians. This is what wins the war.

![Your money buys lobbyists who convince politicians to pass laws that make your money grow. It's corruption, but aimed at curing cancer.](/assets/images/three-actions/three-actions-section-action-2-invest-10-minutes-bw-academic.jpg)

## That's It.

Thirty minutes. That is the whole thing.

![Every 30 minutes, 100 people die from diseases we could prevent. That's the length of a sitcom episode, if sitcoms ended with mass casualties.](/assets/images/three-actions/three-actions-section-that-s-it-bw-academic.jpg)

Vote. Recruit. Invest if you can.

Do it now. Because in the time it took you to read this chapter, another 100 people died from diseases we could have cured yesterday. Their deaths are on the system. Don't let yours be on you.
